meta.title: Pattern Contract v2 — atomic unit with metadata + selector + extensions
meta.signed-by: W1-SOLID, W2-CleanCode, W3-BigO, W4-CC, W5-CI, W6-ISP

definition.description: A Pattern is the atomic, reusable UI unit of the inventory system. It owns a single visual responsibility, declares the capabilities it consumes, and is composable through extensions. Patterns are mounted into Views, never directly into Steps.

invariants.invariant: Patterns NEVER read from a global store; they consume context capabilities declared in `requires`.
Patterns within the same `slotKind` MUST be substitutable (LSP).
Pattern `Component` MUST be lazy(); eager imports are blocked by ESLint.
`selector` MUST be pure and memoized via reselect with structural sharing.
`visibility` MUST be a pure predicate; no hooks, no side effects.
Pattern config drift between definition and instance is rejected at build time.

skip-chain.note: Pattern skip-check is a chain-of-responsibility, not a monolithic if.
skip-chain.step: All required capabilities are resolvable in the provider tree.
session has permissions declared in config.
applied by withFeatureFlag extension if present.
skip-chain.result: If ANY step returns {skip: true, reason}, pattern is omitted from render. Reason is logged.

gates.gate: Every pattern exports a branded PatternId const.
Component is wrapped in lazy(). ESLint rule no-eager-pattern enforces.
selector is wrapped in reselectStable() or equivalent memoizer.
visibility is a pure function (no React imports inside).
requires entries match capability tokens declared in a provider.
slotKind is one of the canonical 6 values.
Pattern bundle size ≤ 80kb gzip (measured per chunk).
